newsitem.title: USA: KTI sees benefit from plant retrofit.
newsitem.headline: KTI sees benefit from plant retrofit.

text.p: KTI Inc said Thursday that the company expects to see a positive impact on earnings from the retrofit of its Timber Energy plant.

In a statement accompanying the release of second quarter earnings today, Martin Sergi, president, said, " The Timber Energy plant, which was acquired last November, was retrofitted to increase the facility's waste processing capabilities. The benefits of this retrofit will be evident in future results."

Today the company reported per-share earnings of $0.11 versus $0.05 in the second quarter, on recurring revenues. In the year-ago quarter the company reported a one-time revenue gain of $33.2 million.
